verdict.reasons: Core defect: product family is mixed — the white/blue AFP cylindrical tape carton is correct, but the irrigation laterals visible along the rows are rigid/round pipes or hoses, not thin flattened drip tape. The QA feedback specifically required a thin flattened drip-tape lateral; that is not met. Additionally, the carton is not placed on a clear lower-left dry-soil island separated by roughly one carton diameter; it sits close to/adjacent to a line, so package_soil_gap_visible is false. The crop identification (okra) is consistent with the article. Watermark and branding are correct. No people, no collage, no implausible geometry, and the carton is not being used as plumbing hardware.
